note: RESTS AND ACCIDENTALS — box every one of them in the cell, and nothing else. These are the two families the 30-epoch cloud run learned to SUPPRESS, because the earlier completion pass boxed only black noteheads and dots and left these as background. Number keys 1-5 are the rest values, 6-8 the inline accidentals, 9 the multi-measure rest bar; the rarer ones (key-signature accidentals, 32nd/64th rests, double accidentals) are clickable in the pass bar. KEY-SIGNATURE accidentals — the run between clef and meter at the head of a staff-start cell — go under keyFlat/keySharp/keyNatural, NOT the inline classes: that is DSv2's own split and the base weights were trained on it. Box each accidental of a key signature individually. Leave noteheads, slurs, ties, hairpins and dots alone — the hollow pass already drew the hollow heads and verdicts accumulate. Tab out of a cell holding none of these: that stamps the pass into inspected_passes and IS the coverage record.
